verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email service, so AI-drafted replies in the user's own voice is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no AI drafting or voice/tone modeling feature. Templates, the JMAP API and API tokens are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate
